usage_rules: Use 'Barlow Condensed' uppercase for all section headers and module titles.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for all data points, IDs, timestamps, and status codes.
Use 'Inter' for long-form text (reports, descriptions) for readability.

rules: Primary color (#00C853) is for active states, borders, and critical data only.
Use 'text-white' for primary text, 'text-zinc-400' for labels.

borders.panel: border-l-2 border-l-[#00C853] border-y border-r border-y-zinc-800 border-r-zinc-800

effects: Scanlines: Overlay a pointer-events-none div with repeating linear gradient for CRT effect (optional toggle).
Grid Background: Use a subtle SVG grid pattern on the main background.
Corner Accents: Add small absolute positioned divs at corners of cards to simulate 'brackets'.

structure: Sidebar: Fixed width (64px collapsed, 240px expanded), glass effect.
Header: Minimal height (48px-64px), contains global status and user profile.
Main Content: Grid layout. 100% height usage. No scroll on main container if possible (internal scrolls for widgets).

general_rules: Border Radius: 0px or very minimal (2px). NO ROUNDED BUTTONS.
Inputs: Flat, dark background (#000000), bottom border only or full box with 1px border.

specific_overrides.Button: uppercase tracking-widest font-bold border border-[#00C853] text-[#00C853] hover:bg-[#00C853] hover:text-black transition-colors rounded-none
specific_overrides.Card: bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-sm border border-zinc-800 rounded-none relative overflow-hidden
specific_overrides.Badge: rounded-none px-2 py-0.5 font-mono text-xs uppercase border

Login.layout: Centered tactical card on a grid map background.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. TAILWIND CONFIG: Update 'tailwind.config.js' to include the custom colors and fonts defined above.
3. GLOBAL CSS: Add the 'scanline' and 'grid-bg' classes to 'index.css'.
4. COMPONENT OVERRIDES: When using Shadcn components, strip the 'rounded-md' classes and replace with 'rounded-none' or 'rounded-sm'. Add 'border-zinc-800' as default border.
5. LAYOUT: Use CSS Grid for the main dashboard layout. Do not use Flexbox for the main structure.
6. DATA-TESTID: Ensure every interactive element has a 'data-testid' attribute.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
